1.d4 d5 2.c4 Nc6 3.cxd5 Qxd5 4.e3 e5 5.N.strategy: Develops with a gain of time on the queen and brings a second piece towards the fight for the centre. The knight can be pinned against the king in reply, so White does not win the tempo it appears to win, and Black keeps its active set-up.

Pins the knight against the king, so it cannot actually take the queen and the queen stays on d5 undisturbed. Black develops with a threat and keeps up the pressure on d4: White has to deal with the pin before it can get its own pieces going.
